Embed Pi operation MCP extension (#217)

  version: 1

  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - embed and securely materialize the repository-owned Pi extension
    - discover and register the operation MCP catalog with server-provided schemas
    - proxy bounded calls with secret redaction, cancellation, and activation-race retries
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-agent-pi`
    - real Pi extension load test
    - `cargo clippy -p codeoo-agent-pi --all-targets -- -D warnings`
